title: Large-Scale Health Data Processing & Smart Wearable Platform
shortDescription: Core digital health platform engineered at Grandm.vn for Japanese corporate clients. Ingests and normalizes continuous health data across Huawei Health, Google Fit, Google Health Connect, and Apple HealthKit for 50,000+ active users with nearly 1 billion cumulative records.

overview.summary: Central health data backbone built at Grandm.vn serving corporate partners and enterprise clients in Japan. Continuously captures, decodes, standardizes, and processes longitudinal health telemetry streaming from users' smart wearables.
overview.background: Japanese corporations emphasize employee wellness programs. However, employees utilize diverse wearable devices (Huawei, Google, Apple) with conflicting data schemas and transmission cycles. This platform unifies all incoming telemetry into a single dependable data repository for corporate wellness reporting.

challenge.title: High-Volume Telemetry Ingestion & System Reliability
challenge.problem: Handling millions of daily telemetry events from over 50,000 active users, archiving nearly 1 billion health records while maintaining resilient, uninterrupted database performance.
bottlenecks: Pronounced traffic spikes during morning synchronization before working hours and post-workout evenings.
Database bloat management as cumulative historical records crossed nearly 1 billion rows.
Managing idempotent webhook processing and reliable retry mechanisms over volatile mobile network connections.

solution.title: Tiered Pipeline with PostgreSQL Partitioning, MySQL & Redis Buffer
solution.approach: Asynchronous queue worker architecture built with PHP/Laravel and Python, leveraging Redis for event buffering, time-range partitioned PostgreSQL for time-series metrics, and MySQL for business relational logic.
keyInnovations: Unified Health Telemetry Schema translating Huawei, Google Fit, and Health Connect payloads into standardized models.
PostgreSQL time-range table partitioning reliably scaling near 1 billion rows without degrading aggregation query performance.
Background worker orchestration for seamless historical data backfills and automated retry logic.

architecture.overview: Low-latency event-driven architecture safeguarding primary database instances.

layers.tech: PHP / Laravel, REST APIs, OAuth2 Token Management
layers.detail: Maintains secure connectivity and automated token refreshes with Huawei Health Kit and Google Cloud servers.

layers.tech: Redis Queue, Python Workers, Background Jobs
layers.detail: Decodes payloads, deduplicates events, and calculates aggregate metrics (heart rate, step counts, sleep stages, calories).
Stores near 1 billion health records on indexed PostgreSQL partitions, alongside MySQL for corporate client profiles.
Administrative corporate dashboard displaying health progress charts and reports tailored for Japanese business clients.

features.title: Multi-Ecosystem Smart Wearable Synchronization
features.description: Single-consent authorization synchronizing data seamlessly with Huawei Health, Google Fit, Health Connect, and Apple HealthKit.
technicalHighlights: Automated background access token renewals preventing sync dropouts.
Historical backfill synchronization for newly onboarded or upgraded smart devices.

features.title: Corporate Health Portal & Wellness Analytics
features.description: Visualizes continuous heart trends, sleep quality stages, and daily physical activity in accordance with corporate reporting standards.
technicalHighlights: Multi-metric corporate dashboard supporting employee wellness tracking.
Custom date range aggregations with periodic report export capabilities.

visuals.title: Japanese Users Embracing Smart Wearables
visuals.description: Engaged corporate and individual users in Japan actively tracking daily heart rate, steps, and wellness metrics on smartwatches.

visuals.title: Corporate Wellness & Health Tracking
visuals.description: Japanese professionals monitoring activity targets and vitals seamlessly synchronized to enterprise health platforms.

takeaways: Partitioning PostgreSQL time-series tables in tandem with Redis Queue reliably supports near 1 billion health records without architectural overengineering.
Abstracting third-party wearable APIs into an isolated internal schema shields business operations from vendor API modifications.
